purpose: Document first-party discovery, public land-record/map route attempts, safe-field limits, and uncertainty.
assessment: Official Tamil Nadu sources evidence an urban land-record procedure using town/block/ward/survey/subdivision keys and the TamilNilam Geo-Info map service operated by the Department of Survey and Settlement. Official Kumbakonam corporation and municipal property-search pages establish local municipal procedure context. The current TamilNilam/e-services and ward/property viewer routes did not return within bounded anonymous requests, while the TN-GIS-NIC page was generic. No safe native parcel ID plus geometry was verified, so no parcel sample is retained.

This is not evidence of an open parcel-vector API or citywide coverage.
